dailyTopic.title: Minimum Wage Increase
dailyTopic.description: Should the federal minimum wage be raised to $20/hour?
dailyTopic.prompt: The federal minimum wage should be raised to $20/hour. This would help millions of workers afford basic necessities and reduce income inequality.

topics.title: Minimum Wage Increase
topics.description: Should the federal minimum wage be raised to $20/hour?
topics.prompt: The federal minimum wage should be raised to $20/hour. This would help millions of workers afford basic necessities and reduce income inequality.

topics.title: Universal Healthcare
topics.description: Should the US adopt a single-payer healthcare system?
topics.prompt: The United States should adopt a single-payer healthcare system similar to those in Canada or the UK. Everyone deserves access to healthcare regardless of employment status.

topics.title: Immigration Reform
topics.description: How should we reform the immigration system?
topics.prompt: We need comprehensive immigration reform that includes a path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants who have been contributing to our communities for years.

topics.title: Climate Policy
topics.description: How aggressively should we pursue carbon emission reductions?
topics.prompt: We should implement aggressive carbon emission targets and transition fully to renewable energy within the next 15 years, even if it means higher energy costs in the short term.

topics.title: School Choice & Vouchers
topics.description: Should public funding follow students to private schools?
topics.prompt: Parents should have the right to use public education funding to send their children to the school of their choice, including private and charter schools.

topics.title: AI Regulation
topics.description: How should governments regulate artificial intelligence?
topics.prompt: Governments should implement strict regulations on AI development and deployment to prevent job displacement and ensure safety, even if it slows innovation.

topics.title: Criminal Justice Reform
topics.description: Should we focus more on rehabilitation or punishment in our justice system?
topics.prompt: Our criminal justice system should prioritize rehabilitation over punishment. Reducing mandatory minimums and investing in education programs within prisons would lower recidivism.

topics.title: Gun Policy
topics.description: What is the right balance between gun rights and public safety?
topics.prompt: We need stricter background checks and waiting periods for all firearm purchases to reduce gun violence while still respecting the Second Amendment.

topics.title: Housing Affordability
topics.description: How should we address the housing affordability crisis?
topics.prompt: Cities should significantly relax zoning regulations and build more high-density housing to address the affordability crisis, even in traditionally single-family neighborhoods.

topics.title: Social Media Regulation
topics.description: Should the government regulate social media platforms?
topics.prompt: Social media companies should be legally required to verify user ages and restrict access for minors under 16 to protect children's mental health.

topics.title: Student Debt Relief
topics.description: Should the government forgive student loan debt?
topics.prompt: The federal government should forgive a significant portion of student loan debt to help a generation burdened by education costs they were told were necessary.

topics.title: Affirmative Action in Admissions
topics.description: Should colleges be able to consider race in admissions?
topics.prompt: Colleges and universities should be allowed to consider race as one factor in admissions to maintain diverse student bodies and address the lasting effects of historical discrimination.

topics.title: Drug Decriminalization
topics.prompt: Personal drug possession should be decriminalized and treated as a public health issue rather than a criminal one. Portugal's model has shown this approach works.

badges.name: Warm Nest
badges.description: Score 9+ on mutual exchange & listening (in a debate)

badges.name: Sharp Beak
badges.description: Score 9+ on reason & expression (in a debate)

questions.prompt: Where do you see yourself politically?
How often do you discuss politics with people who disagree with you?
What issue matters most to you right now?

dimensions.label: Participation
dimensions.description: Staying in the conversation. High scores mean you kept engaging with what the other person said, even when it got tense — rather than dodging, shutting down, or leaving.

dimensions.label: Reason & expression
dimensions.description: Saying what you think and why. High scores mean you shared your own view and backed it up with reasons, examples, or personal experience instead of just stating a position.

dimensions.label: Mutual exchange & listening
dimensions.description: Treating the other person as a real conversation partner. High scores mean you acknowledged their points, asked clarifying questions, and aimed to understand rather than to win.

dimensions.label: Interrogating preconceptions
dimensions.description: Questioning your own view. High scores mean you admitted fair counterpoints, showed some humility, and stayed open to adjusting what you think.
